SELECT PROD.FINPROD_ID as prodid, IFNULL(PROD.FINPROD_ABBR,PROD.FINPROD_NAME) prodname, CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(PROD.ACTMDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') < #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN '已到期' ELSE CASE WHEN D.MDATE IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(D.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN '已到期' ELSE '运作中' END END status, C.JX as interestAmount, C.XJ as cashBalance FROM ( SELECT B.BOOKSET_ID, B.BALANCE_DATE, B.JX, B.XJ, if(@BOOKSET_ID=B.BOOKSET_ID,@rank:=@rank+1,@rank:=1) as newResult FROM ( SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BALANCE_DATE, SUM(CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_NO like '12040101%' THEN A.O_AMT ELSE 0 END) JX, SUM(CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_NO like '10020101%' THEN A.O_AMT ELSE 0 END) XJ FROM BOK_BALANCE A GROUP BY A.BOOKSET_ID,A.BALANCE_DATE ) B , (select @rownum:=0,@BOOKSET_ID:=null,@rank:=0) c
WHERE (B.JX != 0 OR B.XJ != 0) AND DATE_FORMAT(B.BALANCE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') < #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.BOOKSET_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN T.SUBJECT_NO like '40010101%' AND T.O_AMT = 0 THEN T.BALANCE_DATE ELSE NULL END) MDATE FROM BOK_BALANCE T WHERE DATE_FORMAT(T.BALANCE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.BOOKSET_ID ) D ON C.BOOKSET_ID = D.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BOK ON C.BOOKSET_ID = BOK.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON PROD.FINPROD_ID = BOK.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND PROD.FINPROD_TYPE = BOK.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE WHERE C.newResult = 1 AND PROD.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL
